I am an MPH in Epidemiology Candidate at Columbia University Mailman School of Public Health. I received my BA in Psychology from the University of California, Berkeley in May 2023 while rowing as a Division 1 athlete. I worked as a Clinical Research Associate in the de Havenon Lab at the Yale Stroke Center for two years before coming to Columbia. While pursuing my MPH, I also work as a Clinical Research Coordinator in the Brickman Lab at Columbia University's Taub Institute for Research on Alzheimer's Disease and the Aging Brain.
